# Reset and track avatar position step by step
result = action(['ACTION7'])

# Get initial avatar position
def get_avatar_col():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    avatar_b = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b'][0]
    y_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'Y' and min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']) > 30]
    if y_nodes:
        y_col = min(p[1] for p in y_nodes[0]['boundary'])
    else:
        y_col = None
    b_min = min(p[1] for p in avatar_b['boundary'])
    b_max = max(p[1] for p in avatar_b['boundary'])
    return (b_min, b_max, y_col)

print(f"Initial: {get_avatar_col()}")

# Move RIGHT one step at a time
for i in range(10):
    result = action(['RIGHT'])
    pos = get_avatar_col()
    print(f"After RIGHT {i+1}: {pos}")
    if result.get('level_completed') or result.get('game_over'):
        print(f"Level completed or game over!")
        break
